title: Class 8 Science · Cell: Structure and Functions

concepts.name: Cell
concepts.definition: The cell is the basic unit of life. All living things are made of one or more cells.
concepts.hint: Think about the smallest part of a living thing that can still be called alive.
concepts.followUp: Is a bacterium, which is one cell, alive?

misconceptions.correction: Plants are made of cells too. Cells are not only in animals.
misconceptions.followUp: Are the green leaves of a plant made of cells as well?

concepts.name: Nucleus
concepts.definition: The nucleus is the control centre of the cell. It contains the genetic material that carries inherited information.
concepts.hint: Which part of the cell decides what the cell does, like a head office?
concepts.followUp: What does the nucleus pass on when a cell divides?

misconceptions.correction: The nucleus does not make food. It controls the cell and holds the genetic material.
misconceptions.followUp: Which part of the cell does the work of releasing energy from food?

concepts.name: Cell membrane
concepts.definition: The cell membrane is a thin outer covering that controls what enters and leaves the cell.
concepts.hint: What is the thin outer layer that lets some things in and keeps others out?
concepts.followUp: Why is it useful for a cell to let only some substances pass?

misconceptions.correction: The membrane is thin and flexible, not a rigid wall. It lets some substances pass.
misconceptions.followUp: If the membrane were a rigid wall, could food get in?
